current_date: No date in the list text; the council's Local List consultation page says 'The new rules will start on 1 March 2025 depending on the feedback'
current_evidence: The council's 'How to submit a planning application' page links this PDF as its only 'Local Validation Requirements' document. The Local List consultation (10 Dec 2024 to 4 Feb 2025) set a start of 1 March 2025, and a search found no later list.

issues.detail: Every captured local requirement (about 30 rows, all marked 'From type-specific checklist') is placed under 'Outline'. Householder and Full planning both get '(none) - national requirements only'. The list is a single general local list for all application types; it is not an outline-only checklist. Items apply across types: Heritage Statement ('All applications... which affect... heritage assets'), Roof plans (extensions to existing roofs, i.e. householder too), Nitrates Mitigation (any net new dwelling or tourism unit), Flood Risk Assessment, Ecology, Archaeology, Tree Survey and Access visibility sightlines. Reserved matters and Listed building consent also get '(none)', although Heritage Statement and the windows/doors drawings apply to heritage assets. Only the 'Plans showing layout, scale and access' item is genuinely outline or reserved-matters specific.
issues.evidence: List heading 'Local validation requirements'; Heritage Statement: 'All applications, including demolition which affect, or have the potential to affect designated or non-designated heritage assets'; Roof plans: 'Required for all planning applications involving extensions to buildings existing roofs'

issues.detail: Local requirements in the source not captured: Phasing plan (all major development); Statement regarding planning contributions (all applications where development plan policies or SPDs require contributions); Draft unsigned legal agreement (UU, Deed of Variation or s106) or undertaking to pay the Council's fees (where mitigation cannot be secured by condition); Draft Habitat Management and Monitoring Plan (any application with off-site habitat creation for BNG or ecological mitigation); Ground Stability / Behaviour Assessment (operational development in an area of known ground instability); Retail Impact Assessment with sequential assessment (retail element over 2,500 sqm); Agricultural Land Assessment (any loss of agricultural land); Hedgerow Removal Notice / Hedgerow Assessment (removal of protected hedgerows); plans of existing on-site habitats within the red line (major and smaller development unless BNG-exempt); plans showing layout, scale and access (outline where those matters are not reserved).
issues.evidence: e.g. 'Ground Stability / Behaviour Assessment - Applications for operational development located in an area of known ground instability'; 'Agricultural Land Assessment - Required for all developments that would result in the loss of agricultural land'; 'Draft Habitat Management and Monitoring Plan (HMMP) - Required for any application that includes off-site habitat creation'

issues.detail: Several triggers are garbled or merged from adjacent table cells. Transport Assessment and Travel Plan quote Retail Impact Assessment content ('impact... on town centre vitality and viability'); the real trigger is 'all applications where proposals would lead to significant transport implications'. Landscape and Visual Impact Assessment is merged with the external lighting content. Street scene elevations is merged with the windows and doors detail requirements. Land Contamination is cut off at 'Required for all applications where: Core Strategy Policy DM2' and drops the triggers: contamination known or suspected, sensitive end uses, sites on the Council's contaminated sites list, and sites within 250m of landfill. BNG quotes a fragment ('exempt from BNG (please see... The plan must be to scale (with North arrow)'). Highways / access mixes 'Information type Policy references Circumstances when...' header text into the excerpt.
issues.evidence: Transport Assessment / Statement: 'Required for all applications where proposals would lead to significant transport implications'; Retail Impact Assessment: 'retail element exceeds 2,500 square metres'

issues.detail: Some requirement names are mapped to the wrong source item. 'Environmental Statement (EIA)' is mapped to the LVIA trigger; the list has no EIA item, and EIA is the LVIA trigger condition. 'Ground investigation / Geotechnical / Basement Impact Assessment' is mapped to the Hydrogeological Risk Assessment (minerals and groundwater), while the real Ground Stability Assessment is missing. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' is mapped to Arboricultural Method Statement text.
issues.evidence: Grokbot: 'Schedule of works (listed building)' -> 'planting Arboricultural Method Statement that demonstrates how trees will be protected in relation to the finalised design.'

issues.detail: Some rows are content fragments rather than requirements with triggers. 'Design and Access Statement' ('However, if included within the Design and Access Statement it should be clearly labelled.'): DAS is not a local list item. 'Parking provision' ('a separate parking plan is provided.'). 'Photographs / Photomontages' ('Photographs of the trees are also useful.', which is advice inside the tree survey item). 'Block plan' ('location and block plans, must show the direction of north.', a national drawing standard).
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpts as listed; the source has no standalone DAS, parking plan or photographs item

issues.detail: The list date 2025-03-01 is based on PDF metadata (CreationDate), not text. The list itself shows no date. 1 March 2025 matches the start date on the consultation page, so the value is plausible. But the hosted file is 'final_4' and its CMS '?m=' cache parameter corresponds to 25 Aug 2026, so it may have been revised since March 2025 without the list carrying a version date.
issues.evidence: Consultation page: 'The new rules will start on 1 March 2025 depending on the feedback'; workbook Date basis: 'PDF metadata CreationDate'

issues.detail: The tab items are minimal (6 items) and garbled. The Nitrates trigger is split across two tab items, with table header text mixed in ('...net increase in dwellinghouses or Information type Policy references Statement:' and 'Nitrates Circumstances when document should be submitted... tourism accommodation within the nitrate neutrality catchment area'). The section-levels tab item merges the trigger list ('Changes to land levels The winning and working of minerals New buildings') with the scale-bar rule.
issues.evidence: Nitrates Mitigation Strategy Statement: 'Required for all developments that would result in a net increase in dwellinghouses or tourism accommodation within the nitrate neutrality catchment area'

summary: Grokbot's link is the current IoW local validation list (start date 1 March 2025). The extraction wrongly files every local requirement under 'Outline' and shows Householder and Full planning as having no local requirements. It also misses about ten items, including Ground Stability, Retail Impact, Agricultural Land, HMMP, planning contributions/legal agreement and Phasing plan, and several triggers are merged or cut off.
